name: Morino Ookuma
source: Director and father figure at the forest clinic, he is called Mr. Kuma by those around him. He used to be an excellent doctor working at a university hospital in Tokyo, but he quit because he became suspicious of the hospital's policy of not considering the feelings of patients. His wife passed away due to illness.
